## `src/file.rs`

### struct `ConfigFile`

A handle to one TOML config file. The type parameter `T` is the config shape it (de)serializes; the handle is cheap and holds no file descriptor.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ConfigFile<T> {
    path: PathBuf,
    _marker: PhantomData<fn() -> T>,
}
```

## `src/module.rs`

### struct `Module`

A handle to a module's settings directory. Cheap to clone; creates nothing on disk until a write happens (or `ensure_dir` is called).

```rust

pub struct Module {
    dir: PathBuf,
```
